points.title: 出生与早年生活
points.description: 乔布斯出生于美国旧金山，他的早年生活受到了他母亲的影响，她是一位艺术家。乔布斯在硅谷的科技环境中长大，这激发了他对科技的兴趣。他在1972年高中毕业后，前往印度寻求精神上的启迪，并在那里遇到了佛教。这些经历对他后来的生活和职业选择产生了深远的影响。
points.descriptionEn: Steve Jobs was born in San Francisco, United States. His early life was influenced by his mother, an artist. Growing up in the Silicon Valley tech environment, Jobs developed an interest in technology. After graduating from high school in 1972, he traveled to India in search of spiritual enlightenment, where he encountered Buddhism. These experiences had a profound impact on his later life and career choices.

points.place: 美国加利福尼亚州库比蒂诺
points.title: 苹果公司的创立与早期发展
points.titleEn: Founding of Apple and Early Development
points.description: 乔布斯与史蒂夫·沃兹尼亚克共同创立了苹果公司，并推出了Apple I和Apple II个人电脑，这些产品对个人电脑产业的发展产生了重大影响。在苹果公司的早期，乔布斯负责产品设计和营销，他的创新和远见为苹果的成功奠定了基础。然而，由于与公司的管理层的冲突，他在1985年被解雇。
points.descriptionEn: Jobs co-founded Apple with Steve Wozniak and introduced the Apple I and Apple II personal computers, which had a significant impact on the development of the personal computer industry. During Apple's early years, Jobs was responsible for product design and marketing, his innovation and vision laying the foundation for Apple's success. However, due to conflicts with the company's management, he was fired in 1985.

points.place: 美国加利福尼亚州皮茨堡
points.title: NeXT Computer公司的创立与苹果的收购
points.titleEn: Founding of NeXT Computer and Acquisition by Apple
points.description: 在被苹果解雇后，乔布斯创立了NeXT Computer公司，并推出了NeXTstep操作系统。1997年，苹果公司收购了NeXT，乔布斯重返苹果，并最终成为公司的CEO。在他的领导下，苹果推出了iMac、iPod、iPhone和iPad等一系列革命性的产品。
points.descriptionEn: After being fired from Apple, Jobs founded NeXT Computer and introduced the NeXTstep operating system. In 1997, Apple acquired NeXT, and Jobs returned to Apple, eventually becoming the CEO. Under his leadership, Apple introduced a series of revolutionary products, including the iMac, iPod, iPhone, and iPad.

points.place: 美国加利福尼亚州库比蒂诺
points.title: 苹果公司的复兴与乔布斯的影响力
points.titleEn: Revival of Apple and Jobs' Influence
points.description: 在乔布斯的领导下，苹果公司经历了复兴，成为全球最有价值的公司之一。他的设计哲学和营销策略对科技行业产生了深远的影响。乔布斯以其对细节的关注和对创新的追求而闻名，他的领导风格和决策对苹果的成功起到了关键作用。
points.descriptionEn: Under Jobs' leadership, Apple experienced a revival and became one of the most valuable companies in the world. His design philosophy and marketing strategies had a profound impact on the tech industry. Jobs was known for his attention to detail and pursuit of innovation, and his leadership style and decisions played a crucial role in Apple's success.

supporter.zh: 乔布斯被视为一位创新者和企业家，他的贡献在于推动了个人电脑和智能手机的发展，以及他对设计的独特见解。他的精神遗产包括对卓越的追求和对创新的执着。
supporter.en: Steve Jobs is seen as an innovator and entrepreneur, his contributions lie in advancing the development of personal computers and smartphones, as well as his unique insights into design. His legacy includes the pursuit of excellence and the dedication to innovation.

critic.zh: 乔布斯的一些决策和领导风格受到了批评，包括他对员工的严格要求和对待竞争对手的激烈态度。一些人认为他的独裁式管理风格限制了苹果的多元化发展。
critic.en: Some of Jobs' decisions and leadership styles have been criticized, including his strict demands on employees and his aggressive attitude towards competitors. Some argue that his autocratic management style limited the diversification of Apple.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和大众文化中，乔布斯被定义为一位具有深远影响力的科技领袖。他的创新和领导风格对整个科技行业产生了持久的影响，他的产品改变了人们的生活方式。
objective.en: In the academic and popular culture, Steve Jobs is defined as a tech leader with profound influence. His innovation and leadership style have had a lasting impact on the entire tech industry, and his products have changed people's lives.

self.zh: 活着就是为了改变世界，难道还有其他原因吗？
self.en: “I want to put a ding in the universe.”

others.zh: 他是一位天才，他的产品改变了世界。
others.en: “He was a genius, and his products changed the world.”
